ValidationRule.description: Retail 영업기회 등록 시, Closed Won 또는 Closed Lost 로 지정한 경우
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISNEW() = TRUE && RecordType.Name <> "Reinsurance" && (Text(StageName) = "Closed Won" || Text(StageName) = "Closed Lost" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When registering a new opportunity, the stage cannot be specified as Closed Won or Closed Lost.
